title: Gauree, First Mehla:
summary: Gratitude is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
lifeApplication: Let one received thing become a place of praise instead of entitlement. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.

source.lifeApplication: Gratitude becomes more truthful when gauree, First Mehla:.

evidence.turn: Gratitude steadies when o Nanak, they merge into the Lord, and their doubts are cast away.
evidence.practicalImplication: Let one received thing become a place of praise instead of entitlement. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.
